name: Pristine Sin
source:
A story about Blake, a rebel hell-bent on vengeance, who finds a gentle amnesia-suffering demon named Eddo from a desert. Later the two are accompanied by a quirky girl Suki who is a fellow rebel, and the three of them end up on a quest to find five beings called angels, before the empire of Circinus find them to exploit their powers to conquer the world.

[From [url=https://gods-of-maa.tumblr.com/tagged/download]The Official Webite[/url]]
